texts.1b0b3d99065d:
Aim: To establish a resource for studies of the genetic epidemiology of lung cancer in North Trent, comprising quality genomic and plasma DNA, tumour and plasma samples, linked to detailed family history and lifestyle questionnaires from lung cancer patients and their families.
To study single nucleotide polymorphisms for candidate lung cancer susceptibility genes in genomic DNA from patients and controls; to study changes of lung cancer in plasma DNA from patients and controls.
texts.60bd8d63cb2f: The data supplied by the NHSIC to Cancer Research Centre will be used only for the approved Medical Research Project MR1081.
